7. Another classmate, Judy, is taking part in a swimming competition on Friday.

items.title: 背诵 · The Wind and the Sun
items.prompt:
Wind: I am stronger than you, Sun.
Sun: No way. I am stronger than you, and I will show you.
Do you see that man down there?
Can you make him take off his coat?
Wind: Of course I can.
Man: Oh, it's cold.
Sun: The man didn't take off his coat.
Man: Gee, it's even colder.
Sun: Ha, ha, he still has his coat on.
Wind: Okay, now you try.
Man: How strange! It's getting warmer now!
Wind: See, the man still has his coat on.
Sun: Just wait. You'll see.
Man: Oh, now it's hot.
Sun: See, I did it! I did it! The man took off his coat!

items.prompt:
Aunt Picky
Aunt Picky wants a pumpkin. Oh which one will I buy?
The big one? The small one? The fat one? The tall one? I just can’t decide!
Is this one as good as that one? It’s better(bigger) than the fat one.
It’s bigger than the next one. Oh, which one is the best one?!
She looks and thinks… And thinks and looks…
And there in front of her eyes，
She sees the best of all the pumpkins to put into her pie!
Look, lady which one do you want? Asks the pumpkin man.
I need to go home as soon as I can. Aunt Picky frowns and cries a lot.
“I’m sorry,”she says,“but I forgot.”

items.title: A Special School Day
items.prompt:

on a field trip to the zoo. She packed her favorite lunch—a peanut butter sandwich and a

road. At the zoo, she saw big hippos jumping in the water and beautiful birds flying over

with her friends. They all felt happy.
As the sun began to set, she went back home, thinking of all the amazing animals
she saw that day.

items.title: A Busy Saturday
items.prompt:

helped his mom clean the room and water the plants. In the afternoon, he cooked
dinner together with his dad. They made pasta with tomato sauce. After dinner, Jack

was very tired, but he was happy, because he helped his family a lot. His mom said,

her home. It was a busy weekend, but Jack learned that doing chores together makes
the family happy.

2. They cooked dinner together and made pasta with tomato sauce.
3. He cleaned the room, watered the plants, did the dishes and fed his dog.（至少两项。）
